description: This file contains unit tests for the ProjectServiceImpl class in a Java project, specifically testing project creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion functionalities.

classes.name: ProjectServiceImplUTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the ProjectServiceImpl class methods using Mockito for mocking dependencies.

methods.name: testCreateProjectShouldCreateProject
methods.description: Tests the creation of a project, ensuring the saveProject method is called once.

methods.name: testGetProjetcWithProjectIdShouldReturnProjectWithThatProjectId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a project by its ID, verifying the correct project is returned.

methods.name: testUpdateProjectThatExistShouldUpdateProject
methods.description: Tests updating an existing project, verifying the find and save methods are called appropriately.

methods.name: testUpdateProjectThatDoesNotExistShouldThrowException
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when attempting to update a non-existent project, and the save method is not called.

methods.name: testDeleteExistingProjectShouldDeleteExistingProject
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an existing project, verifying the removeProject method call.

methods.name: testDeleteExistingProjectThatDoesNotExistShouldThrowException
methods.description: Verifies that deleting a non-existent project throws a RuntimeException.
